newsitem.title: USA: Orphan Medical licenses Fabray Disease drug.
newsitem.headline: Orphan Medical licenses Fabray Disease drug.

text.p: Orphan Medical Inc said Monday it licensed alpha-galactosidase A for the treatment of Fabray Disease, an enzyme deficiency that afflicts between 1,500 and 2,000 patients in the United States.
The disesase results in the accumulation of the toxin ceramidetrihexoside in the body, Orphan Medical said. The company added there is currently no effective threapy for the disease.
Orphan Medical develops, licenses and markets drugs used to treat uncommon diseases.
Its shares were trading up 1/8 Monday at 6-5/8.
